_note: EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema. THE WHOLE SURFACE WENT LIVE with the #4509 materializer bridge — this file previously recorded the webhook (#3461) disconnect shape, all 13 props dead, and it is kept as the worked example that a dead verdict is a worklist entry, not a tombstone: enforce-or-remove resolved this one by ENFORCING. What carries it NOW (2026-10-11, ADR-0131 D6/D10, ruling C on §6 Q1): the bridge that copied declared items into `sys_email_template` rows retired together with the built-in seed, the boot sweep and the live projector. `createRegistryEmailTemplateLoader` (packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts) reads `email_template` metadata from the registry by (name, locale) at every send — the protocol's layered execution list, the environment's item over each code package's declaration — and the built-in auth templates are code-declared items of the email plugin's own package (`EmailServicePlugin.init` registers them through its manifest). Each candidate is validated through `EmailTemplateDefinitionSchema` (`safeParse` in the loader — the spec schema keeps a real consumer, defaults and all; a malformed item refuses the send instead of falling through to the built-in) and carried into the render input by `toRenderInput`; `EmailService.resolveAndRenderTemplate` renders it and `sendTemplate` keeps the envelope reads. A Studio save is in the layered list the moment it lands, so it is live on the next send with no subscription and no projection. The ADR-0054 proof (`email-template-materialization`) asserts that an app-authored override of a BUILT-IN auth template is what reaches the transport, that the built-in still serves the locales the app leaves out, and that a Studio save over the authored item sends without a restart. Two keys lost their only consumer with the rows: `category` and `isSystem` were read by nothing but the row projection (a Setup column and the built-in seeder's stand-down), and are `dead` from 2026-10-11 — see their rows. `label` and `description` are read by the Studio metadata list. `protection`/_lock*/_provenance are framework overlay fields, auto-live. 2026-08-28 (commit 8cb96ec41): every citation in this file was re-anchored to its consuming symbol.
